description: Post-T0 apparatus surface: the tool names and schema hash the local `lovspor mcp` server serves after the ADR-0009 T0 serving-side notice (get_law appends a temporal notice block, get_section carries a temporal_notice field; both tool descriptions changed accordingly). Supersedes tool-surface-v1.json for FUTURE runs; v1 stays committed untouched because the committed LLHB v1 pair recorded its hash and must remain verifiable (pass --surface-path for v1 re-checks). The surface is corpus-independent (the schemas come from build_server, not the documents) but interpreter-dependent: tool descriptions come from docstrings, and CPython 3.13 dedents docstrings at compile time, so the hash is only defined together with the `python` field below. A unit test regenerates this document from the code on every run — names on every interpreter, hash on the apparatus interpreter; if the served surface changes, that test fails and changing this file is an explicit apparatus decision, not drift. check_fairness.py reads this document as the expectation the declared tool_config is compared against.
